name: EBAYC Volunteers and Student Internships
what_you_do: You can volunteer at a youth group. You can also do a student internship there. The group offers life coaching, school partnerships and community organizing.
how_to_apply: The home page has a Sign Up button for volunteers, but the volunteer page it links to showed a 404 error on 2026-10-09. Contact EBAYC directly (offices in Oakland and Sacramento are listed on the home page).
notes: Read the home page on 2026-10-09. It says EBAYC has many volunteer opportunities and welcomes volunteer groups and student internships, but it gives no ages, dates or pay. The volunteer page linked from it (ebayc.org/volunteer/) returned a 404 error on Oct 7 and again on Oct 9, 2026. Confirm the minimum age with EBAYC.
